title: Punjab Public Defender Service Act 2007 Repeal Act 2012

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Public Defender Service Act 2007 Repeal Act 2012
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XL OF 2012
ACT XL OF 2012
PUNJAB PUBLIC DEFENDER SERVICE
ACT, 2007 (REPEAL) ACT, 2012
An Act to repeal the Punjab Public Defender Service
Act, 2007 (XIV of 2007)
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary
22nd June, 2012]
No.PAP-Legis-2(108)/2011/708,
dated 22-6-2012.---The Punjab Public Defender Service
Act 2007 (Repeal) Bill 2011, originally passed by the Provincial Assembly of
the Punjab on the 8th day of March 2012, was sent to the Governor of the Punjab for assent. The Governor returned the Bill for
reconsideration by the Assembly. The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab, after reconsideration, again passed the Bill on
the 7th day of June 2012. The Bill was again sent to the Governor for assent on
the 9th day of June 2012. Since the Governor has not assented to the Bill
within the stipulated period of ten days, the same is deemed to have been
assented to in terms of clause (3) of Article 116 of the Constitution, and is
published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
Whereas it is expedient
to repeal the Punjab Public Defender Service Act 2007 (XIV of 2007);
It is enacted as follows:---
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be cited as the Punjab Public Defender Service Act, 2007
(Repeal) Act, 2012.
(2) It shall come into force
at once.
